articles.title: From Emperors to World Records: The Surprising Story Behind Your Ice Cream
articles.summary: July is National Ice Cream Month, but did you know your favorite flavor might reveal your personality? Plus, the world's largest scoop weighed over 3,000 pounds. Here's the scoop on ice cream's wild history and weird records.

articles.title: 'It's Not Normal': Djokovic, 39, Defies Age in Five-Hour Wimbledon Thriller
articles.summary: Novak Djokovic, at 39, battled for over five hours to beat a player 14 years younger at Wimbledon. His opponent called it 'not normal.' The 24-time Grand Slam champion is now one win from history.

articles.title: A Lavender Haze at MSG: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's Star-Studded Wedding
articles.summary: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wed at Madison Square Garden in a closely guarded ceremony. The Empire State Building flashed 'JUST&T MARRIED!' as fans gathered. Swift's Dior gown and the couple's unique wedding party made headlines.
